bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Personal Income Tax Plan) Bill 2018

name: The majority voted against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2018-05-23.98.2) introduced by Labor MP [Chris Bowen](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/mcmahon/chris_bowen) (McMahon), which means it failed. ### Motion text > *That all words after "That" be omitted with a view to substituting the following words:* > *"whilst not declining to give [the bill](http://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r6111) a [second reading](https://www.peo.gov.au/learning/fact-sheets/making-a-law.html), the House calls on the Government to:* > *(1) amend the bill to separate the measures which implement personal income tax relief from 1 July 2018, so that these measures can be passed by the Parliament without delay;* > *(2) introduce new legislation implementing the remainder of the measures in the bill only when further financial information, including year-on-year costs of each step of the Government’s full seven-year personal income tax scheme, is made available to the Parliament; and* > *(3) support the Opposition’s personal income tax plan to deliver bigger, better and fairer tax relief to Australians.*
